title: A Comparative Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Techniques for Single Open-Circuit Fault in a Packed E-Cell Inverter
content: Recently, fault detection has proven its crucial role in guaranteeing the safety and dependability of inverter functioning. This paper demonstrates the effectiveness of employing Artificial Intelligence (AI) approaches for fault detection of single Open Circuit (OC) switch fault in a Packed E-Cell (PEC) inverter. Two optimum strategies have been considered Random Forest Decision Tree (RFDT) and Feedforward Neural Network (FFNN). Initially, Discrete Wavelet Analysis (DWA) is employed for the investigation of the output voltage, using the first level of detailed coefficients. After that, three statistical features are extracted from this analysis to serve as input to the classifier during learning. The output of the classifier, which is referred to the fault class, is then trained according to each strategy process. Finally, a comparison with deep analysis based on selected criteria is illustrated and the results obtained using MATLAB/Simulink confirm the comprehensive review of the evaluated strategies.
